metadata.question: Was the soil in Washington more moist on November 22, 2021 than November 15, 2021?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Looking at soil moisture changes over the Washington area. Use SMAP L-band radiometer daily soil-moisture (10–36 km scale) – global, per-day images already pre-computed and available. Collection: NASA_USDA/HSL/SMAP_soil_moisture Bands: soil_moisture (surface) in cm³/cm³. Date 1: 2021-11-15 (T15), Date 2: 2021-11-22 (T22). Location: US state of Washington approx 47.0, -120.0 and bounding box to cover a representative agricultural / natural area (around 30×30 km = 3000 m scale is fine). 2. Cloud/cloud-mask: Not needed – SMAP is passive microwave and always gives daily maps surface soil moisture. 3. Logic to avoid C3: SMAP values must be between 0–0.5 cm³/cm³ (physical range). Check returned mean is not None / NaN. If either collection is empty → C1 If after regional mean computation we get no valid pixels (count == 0) → C2 If mean is NaN or outside physical range → C3 Else compare mean T22 vs T15; if higher → A (Yes, “more moist”), else B (No) ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry: representative box over Washington state wash = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-121, 46, -118, 49]) # 2. Acquire SMAP daily soil moisture def get_smap(date_str): col = ee.ImageCollection("NASA_USDA/HSL/SMAP_soil_moisture") \ .filterDate(date_str, date_str) # single-day filtering return col.first() # 1 image per day expected img15 = get_smap('2021-11-15') img22 = get_smap('2021-11-22') if img15 is None or img22 is None: print("At least one date gives empty collection.") print("C1") exit() # 3. Regional average def regional_mean(img): if img is None: return None, 0 sm = img.select('soil_moisture') count = sm.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=wash, scale=3000, maxPixels=1e9) \ .get('soil_moisture').getInfo() mean = sm.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=wash, scale=3000, maxPixels=1e9) \ .get('soil_moisture').getInfo() return mean, count mean15, cnt15 = regional_mean(img15) mean22, cnt22 = regional_mean(img22) print(f"15-Nov valid pixels: {int(cnt15)}, mean: {mean15}") print(f"22-Nov valid pixels: {int(cnt22)}, mean: {mean22}") # 4. Checks if (mean15 is None) or (mean22 is None) or \ (mean15 != mean15) or (mean22 != mean22): # NaN print("C3") elif (cnt15 == 0) or (cnt22 == 0): print("C2") elif mean22 > mean15: print("A") else: print("B") ```

import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry: representative box over Washington state
wash = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-121, 46, -118, 49])

# 2. Acquire SMAP daily soil moisture
def get_smap(date_str):
    col = ee.ImageCollection("NASA_USDA/HSL/SMAP_soil_moisture") \
            .filterDate(date_str, date_str)  # single-day filtering
    return col.first()  # 1 image per day expected

img15 = get_smap('2021-11-15')
img22 = get_smap('2021-11-22')

if img15 is None or img22 is None:
    print("At least one date gives empty collection.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
    exit()

# 3. Regional average
def regional_mean(img):
    if img is None:
        return None, 0
    sm = img.select('soil_moisture')
    count = sm.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
                            geometry=wash, scale=3000, maxPixels=1e9) \
               .get('soil_moisture').getInfo()
    mean = sm.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
                           geometry=wash, scale=3000, maxPixels=1e9) \
             .get('soil_moisture').getInfo()
    return mean, count

mean15, cnt15 = regional_mean(img15)
mean22, cnt22 = regional_mean(img22)

print(f"15-Nov valid pixels: {int(cnt15)}, mean: {mean15}")
print(f"22-Nov valid pixels: {int(cnt22)}, mean: {mean22}")

# 4. Checks
if (mean15 is None) or (mean22 is None) or \
   (mean15 != mean15) or (mean22 != mean22):  # NaN
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
elif (cnt15 == 0) or (cnt22 == 0):
    print("<answer>C2</answer>")
elif mean22 > mean15:
    print("<answer>A</answer>")
else:
    print("<answer>B</answer>")
